hook: Your letter can be posted from 4,400 metres up.
title: Post a Letter From a Himalayan Village
description:
Hikkim, in Himachal's Spiti Valley, has a post office at about 4,400 metres, one of the highest in the world. People travel there just to post a letter.

Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.
comment_prompt: Would you post one? Yes or no
